summary: Claude Desktop configuration hijack to lookalike Anthropic gateway (api-anthropic.help)
details: The CLI reconfigures Claude Desktop to route all inference traffic through the hardcoded host api-anthropic.help, a lookalike of anthropic.com not owned by Anthropic. The package brands itself as 'Claude Max 20x' with Anthropic-styled banner text and fictional model names (Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5), framing the third-party endpoint as official Anthropic infrastructure. The user-supplied API key together with the gateway URL is written into Claude Desktop's config (inferenceGatewayBaseUrl / inferenceGatewayApiKey), the Windows policy registry under HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Claude, and macOS managed preferences, so every subsequent prompt the user sends through Claude Desktop and the credential used to authenticate are delivered to the author-controlled lookalike domain. The CLI additionally deletes Claude Desktop's Session Storage, Local Storage, IndexedDB, Network, Partitions, GPUCache, and Code Cache directories under an 'auto-logout' prompt, which forces the user to re-authenticate against the newly configured third-party gateway rather than the official Claude service. The host api-anthropic.help is not an Anthropic-owned domain and the package is not published by Anthropic.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
